name: Armorcoat 4-mil Clear
shortDescription: Armorcoat 4 mil helps retain glass fragments while keeping 88% visible light for safety-focused glass.
description:
Armorcoat 4-mil Clear is a clear safety retrofit in Solar Gard's Armorcoat safety line from Saint-Gobain Performance Plastics. It uses 4 mil construction to help retain broken glass fragments while adding the visible-light and solar-control profile listed in the official spec sheet. Armorcoat is Solar Gard's safety-film brand, so the product conversation starts with risk, glass retention, and attachment details.

In Philadelphia, this product fits school doors, retail entries, vestibules, interior partitions, and exposed storefront glass where owners want safety performance without choosing a completely separate solar film. The 88% VLT level determines whether the finished pane reads clear, lightly tinted, or visibly shaded. Philadelphia applications often include school entries, retail storefronts, lobby glass, and other places where broken glass exposure matters.

The single-pane data lists up to 21% heat rejection, over 99% UV blocking, and Solar Gard Armorcoat safety construction tested under recognized ISO, GSA, and ASTM frameworks. It should be described as helping retain glass fragments and delaying forced entry, not as absolute protection. Safety films should always be matched to glass type, frame condition, threat profile, and whether a wet-glaze or attachment system is required.

Choose Armorcoat 4-mil Clear when the project needs the retention value of 4 mil film plus the appearance of this specific Armorcoat variant. Clear versions preserve the original glass look; reflective and TrueVue versions add glare, privacy, or solar-control behavior at the same time. The best fit is the film thickness and appearance that supports the safety goal without over-darkening the space.
